entries.statement: Balance and every due position are obligation-scoped, knowledge-timed assertions mastered by WM-POL-011 and never owned by a tax registration account.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: A jurisdictional basis never entails registration, and an address alone entails neither registration nor obligation.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Each residence, source, place-of-supply or nexus basis remains independently identified, evidenced and resolvable with or without an account.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Residence, source, place-of-supply and nexus remain distinct and obey the closed basis-to-subject-kind table.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Concurrent jurisdictional bases coexist without implicit ranking, suppression or netting.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Every time-varying assertion is read with mandatory effective and knowledge instants; authority timestamps remain separately recorded.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Account state is revision-owned; currentState is derived and cannot be mutated in place.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Version lineage is backward supersedesRef only, acyclic, single-parent and never identified by content digest.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Authority identifiers are interval-qualified by authority, jurisdiction and tax type; local identities are never recycled.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: A balance is neither a second master of an assessment or payment nor erasable into either.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: A procedure case and an authority response correlate facts but never own obligations, assessments, notices, acknowledgements or economic amounts.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Every calculation has exactly one owner: ReturnRevision or Obligation; an authority-assessed calculation remains Obligation-owned and requires assessmentRef.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Equal amounts or digests never merge calculations, returns, assessments, obligations or accounts.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Registration never implies an obligation and a basis never implies registration.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: All candidate objects are restricted by default; reads are purpose-bound, actor-bound and knowledge-time logged.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: A taxable event, obligation and payment may coexist with zero tax registration accounts and zero return revisions.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: An account is instantiated only from an authority handle or an explicit opening/application event naming the authority.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Every rule, rate, formula, form, schema, taxonomy and code-set dependency is an opaque effective-and-knowledge-time version pin; local rate copies are forbidden.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Deregistration archives by tombstone and never erases prior obligations, returns, assessments, responses or lineage.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Retention is at least the maximum of an externally pinned statutory minimum and any active legal hold.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: Return class is declared explicitly and never inferred from account, taxpayer, period or payload similarity.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding

entries.statement: TaxProfile is a non-storing view with no masters; obligation scope uses taxTypeRef and obligationClass instead.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-07 tax obligation, return, filing and optional registration binding
